request.system: Determine whether the proposed hypothesis or expression explicitly avoids a failure described in the report. Return JSON only: {"avoids_failure": true|false|null}. Use null when the evidence is unclear.
request.prompt:
{"report": "**Migration report**

**What worked:** Standardizing V05's year-over-year change against its own expanding history gave a modestly positive rank IC (about 0.06, HAC t 2.2). Correlation with base features was low. Lagging it one month weakened the signal (IC 0.04, t 1.4), so freshness matters. Signal strength appeared stronger when T was high.

**What failed:** Counting the share of recent months in which V05 rose (six-month persistence) gave a negative IC (about -0.07, t -1.8). It contradicted my hypothesis and has high rank autocorrelation. Standardizing V03 against its expanding history produced essentially zero IC and weak coverage.

**Caveat:** Coverage of the best feature is only about 63%, and its sign was opposite to my stated hypothesis, so treat it cautiously.", "hypothesis": "Groups with V03 high relative to V04, both standardized on a 60-month window and lightly smoothed over 3 months, will have higher next-month returns, extending the only significant positive result (submission 4) with modest noise reduction.", "expression": "spread(mavg(tsz(V03,60),3),mavg(tsz(V04,60),3))"}
